gmixup.what: Estimates one graphon per class (USVT), interpolates them and samples new graphs.
gmixup.good_for: Graph level: oversampling of classes of whole graphs (e.g. MUTAG-like datasets).
gmixup.avoid_when: Graphs with more than 200 nodes: only the 200 highest-degree nodes are used for the estimate. Repo without a license.

ifmixup.what: Interpolates adjacency and features of two graphs padded to the same size, then samples the edges.
ifmixup.good_for: Graph level: oversampling of whole graphs whose nodes are already in a consistent order.
ifmixup.avoid_when: No node alignment between the two graphs: the interpolation may have no structural meaning. Authors/year not verified.

smote_graph.what: SMOTE on whole graphs: interpolates two neighboring graphs of the same class after ordering the nodes by degree.
smote_graph.good_for: Graph level: oversampling of minority classes of graphs.
smote_graph.avoid_when: Not a published method as such (our application of the SMOTE idea); alignment by degree only.

ros_graph.what: Exact copy of training graphs of the target class.
ros_graph.good_for: Graph level: reference baseline for oversampling.
ros_graph.avoid_when: No new variability: it only duplicates.

smixup.what: Graph mixup with soft node alignment through a matching network (GMNet) trained with triplet loss.
smixup.good_for: Graph level: oversampling of graphs with different structure across examples (learned alignment).
smixup.avoid_when: Requires GPU. GPL-3.0 license (DIG): to be assessed for distribution. Label = target class, not a loss mixup.

sbm.what: Estimates a stochastic block model from a donor graph (spectral clustering) and samples a new one.
sbm.good_for: Graph level: graphs with community structure; features are copied from the donor.
sbm.avoid_when: Captures only block structure, not fine motifs; features are not generated.

graphvae.what: Conditional VAE (MLP) on the degree-ordered adjacency, without graph matching.
graphvae.good_for: Graph level: generation of small graphs.
graphvae.avoid_when: At most 64 nodes (larger graphs are truncated). With few epochs it is only a smoke test. Requires GPU.

flag.what: Adversarial examples of the node features (PGD on a trained GIN), structure and label unchanged.
flag.good_for: Graph level: augmentation by feature perturbation.
flag.avoid_when: Node features are required. Static output, not the per-step perturbation as in the paper. Requires GPU.

graphcl_dnodes.what: GraphCL perturbation: deletes nodes (10 %); the deleted nodes remain isolated.
graphcl_dnodes.good_for: Graph level: perturbed view of a training graph of the target class.

graphcl_pedges.what: GraphCL perturbation: removes 10 % of the edges (does not add any).
graphcl_pedges.good_for: Graph level: perturbed view of a training graph of the target class.

graphcl_subgraph.what: GraphCL perturbation: keeps a subgraph (20 % of the nodes).
graphcl_subgraph.good_for: Graph level: perturbed view of a training graph of the target class.

graphcl_maskn.what: GraphCL perturbation: masks 10 % of the node features.
graphcl_maskn.good_for: Graph level: perturbed view of a training graph of the target class.

ga_nodesam.what: GraphAug augmentation (Yoo et al., WWW 2022): splits one node into two (NodeSam).
ga_nodesam.good_for: Graph level: light perturbed views of training graphs.

ga_submix.what: GraphAug augmentation (Yoo et al., WWW 2022): mixes in a substructure from another graph (SubMix); soft label in y_soft.
ga_submix.good_for: Graph level: light perturbed views of training graphs.

ga_graphcrop.what: GraphAug augmentation (Yoo et al., WWW 2022): crops a connected subgraph (GraphCrop).
ga_graphcrop.good_for: Graph level: light perturbed views of training graphs.

ga_dropnode.what: GraphAug augmentation (Yoo et al., WWW 2022): deletes a node.
ga_dropnode.good_for: Graph level: light perturbed views of training graphs.

ga_dropedge.what: GraphAug augmentation (Yoo et al., WWW 2022): deletes an edge.
ga_dropedge.good_for: Graph level: light perturbed views of training graphs.

ga_addedge.what: GraphAug augmentation (Yoo et al., WWW 2022): adds an edge.
ga_addedge.good_for: Graph level: light perturbed views of training graphs.

ga_motifswap.what: GraphAug augmentation (Yoo et al., WWW 2022): swaps a motif (MotifSwap).
ga_motifswap.good_for: Graph level: light perturbed views of training graphs.

nl_dropedge.good_for: Node level: perturbed view for contrastive training/regularization (DropEdge).
nl_dropedge.avoid_when: Blind removal: it may drop important edges (inferred from the method).

nl_edgeadd.good_for: Node level: perturbed view of the structure.
nl_edgeadd.avoid_when: PyGCL's code does not symmetrize the added edges.

nl_nodedrop.what: Removes the edges of randomly chosen nodes (pn=0.1); the nodes stay.
nl_nodedrop.avoid_when: The nodes stay in the graph, isolated, with their features and labels.

nl_nodeshuffle.what: Permutes the features across nodes (DGI-style corruption).
nl_nodeshuffle.good_for: Node level: corrupted view for contrastive learning.
nl_nodeshuffle.avoid_when: Features are no longer aligned with the labels: unsuitable for direct supervised training.

nl_featmask.good_for: Node level: perturbed view of the features (GRACE).

nl_featdrop.good_for: Node level: perturbed view of the features.

nl_ppr.what: Personalized PageRank diffusion, sparsified by keeping the E edges of highest weight.
nl_ppr.good_for: Node level: diffused view of the graph (MVGRL/GDC).
nl_ppr.avoid_when: Sparsification removes self-loops and can change the structure a lot. Cost not documented.

nl_markov.good_for: Node level: diffused view of the graph.
nl_markov.avoid_when: Order 8 chosen for run time, not from the paper.

nl_heat.what: Heat kernel diffusion (PyG's GDC), top-k edges per node with k = average degree.
nl_heat.good_for: Node level: diffused view of the graph.

nl_rwsample.what: Samples nodes with random walks (10 % of seeds, 10 steps) and keeps the edges between visited nodes.
nl_rwsample.good_for: Node level: subsampled view of the graph.
nl_rwsample.avoid_when: Own code, not PyGCL's (which requires torch_sparse, not installed).

nl_egosample.what: Samples the k-hop subgraph (5 % of seeds, 2 hops) with PyG's k_hop_subgraph.
nl_egosample.good_for: Node level: local view of the graph.

nl_guided_drop.what: Removes edges guided by centrality (GCA style).
nl_guided_drop.good_for: Node level: perturbed view that preserves central nodes (inferred from the method).
nl_guided_drop.avoid_when: Own implementation, not GCA's original code.

nl_guided_perturb.what: Removes edges with low feature similarity and adds cosine kNN edges.
nl_guided_perturb.avoid_when: Heuristic not published as a method in its own right.

nl_grand.good_for: Node level: regularizing view of the features.
nl_grand.avoid_when: Only the augmentation, not GRAND's consistency training.

nl_vgae_edges.what: A VGAE adds the most probable edges and removes the least probable ones (GAug-M idea).
nl_vgae_edges.avoid_when: Requires GPU; dense N x N matrix, N at most 10000. Rewrite, not GAug's code.

nl_flag.what: GCN trained on the train set, then PGD (K=3) on the features: exports x + delta.
nl_flag.avoid_when: Requires GPU. Rewrite of the PGD step only, not FLAG's training.

nl_gs_upsample.what: Duplicates nodes of the minority classes together with their adjacencies (GraphSMOTE, upsampling setting).
nl_gs_upsample.good_for: Node level: node classification with imbalanced classes (3 minority classes).
nl_gs_upsample.avoid_when: Repo without a license. No new variability.

nl_gs_smote.what: SMOTE on the features with the parent's adjacency (GraphSMOTE, smote setting).
nl_gs_smote.good_for: Node level: node classification with imbalanced classes.
nl_gs_smote.avoid_when: Repo without a license; portion increased by ~1 node per class because of a bug in the repo.

nl_graphsmote.what: Full GraphSMOTE: SAGE encoder, SMOTE in embedding space, edge decoder.
nl_graphsmote.good_for: Node level: node classification with imbalanced classes.
nl_graphsmote.avoid_when: Requires GPU; dense N^2 adjacency, N at most 10000. Repo without a license.

nl_graphens.what: Node synthesis with ego-networks (neighbor sampling + saliency mixup).
nl_graphens.good_for: Node level: minority classes in imbalanced graphs.

nl_node_mixup.what: Mixup of pairs of nodes of the same class (lambda ~ Beta(2,2)), edges from the dominant node.
nl_node_mixup.good_for: Node level: oversampling of minority classes.

nl_cvae_nodes.what: CVAE on the features of the training nodes; edges to the 3 most similar nodes of the same class.
nl_cvae_nodes.good_for: Node level: generating nodes of a class.
nl_cvae_nodes.avoid_when: Few training nodes: limited quality. Requires GPU.

nl_gaug_orig.what: Original GAug-M/GAug-O: VGAE + classifier to edit the edges.
nl_gaug_orig.avoid_when: DESCRIBED ONLY, not runnable: requires torch 1.4 + DGL 0.4.2 + pyro + optuna. Use nl_vgae_edges.

nl_graphmix.avoid_when: DESCRIBED ONLY, not runnable: the augmentation is internal to the training, not exportable as a graph.

nl_dropedge_repo.avoid_when: DESCRIBED ONLY, not runnable: function covered by nl_dropedge.

nl_nodeaug.what: Perturbation of features and structure with consistency (NodeAug, KDD 2020).
nl_nodeaug.avoid_when: DESCRIBED ONLY, not runnable: no code found.
